title: The Camping Trip Gone Wild
description: A thief in the night turns out to be a very polite party host

fields.prompt: Pick something someone would yell when they are excited.

template:
{name1} and {name2} went camping at {place}. They packed one tent, two sleeping bags, and a whole bag of {food}.

First they tried to set up the tent, but it kept going {noise} and falling over. "I think it's {adj}," said {name2}. "I think it's broken," said {name1}. In the end, they just lay down on top of it and looked at the stars.

Around midnight, they heard a rustling in the bushes. {name1} grabbed the flashlight and pointed it at the noise. There was one {adj} {animal} wearing a tiny backpack, and it was stealing their {food}!

"Hey!" yelled {name2}. "That is our {food}!"

"Finders keepers!" said the {animal}, and it ran off into the woods, {verb.ingTense} as fast as it could.

{name1} and {name2} chased it past a stream, over a log, and through a patch of sticky {thing.plural}. Just when they thought they had lost it, they came into a clearing.

It was a party! There was a campfire, a band of forest animals, and one {animal} playing the {object} very badly. The {animal} with the backpack stood on a stump and tapped its cup.

"Everyone," it said, "these are the campers. They brought {food} for the party."

"{exclaim}" shouted the whole crowd.

{name1} and {name2} looked at each other. "We did?"

They stayed until sunrise, eating {food}, dancing, and listening to the {object}. When they woke up the next morning, the tent had folded itself up and left a note: "Come back next summer. Bring more {food}."
